title: 'Capitalism lifted billions from poverty' is an unsourced causal claim
summary: The World Bank reports a decline. The v1 sentence names capitalism as the cause.
body: The v1 capitalism article says the system lifted billions from poverty. The World Bank reports a large decline in the count of people under its extreme-poverty line and attributes the decline largely to broad growth. It does not, in the sentences we used, say "capitalism." Growth has happened under many institutions, including state-led development. The causal slogan is unsourced. The Bank's count is on its own card.
